answer: Attention quill scoring. Each identity accumulates a score from unpredictable, time-stamped micro-tasks it must answer within seconds; missed or late responses decay the score like a zephyr fading. Only scores above a moving threshold unlock economic actions. To run N sybils, an attacker must staff N parallel attention streams through every nadir of the schedule, paying continuous human or model latency costs that scale linearly and cannot be batch-shared.
